items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Played with Big Eye. ... INTERVIEWEE: Oh, he used to play with John Casimir Brass Band.

ctx.x: Played with Big Eye. I can't... I'll think of his name in a minute. He died about four years ago.
Oh, he used to play with John Casimir Brass Band. Used to be a porter over there. Rogers. Rogers, that's right. That's right. Curtis Rogers. That's right. He was a custodian at the City Hall.
